title: Evaluator counted true source details as reader intrusions
observed_failure: The metric penalised readers for statements the curated gold omitted even when the source stated them; 70 of 124 flagged 'unsupported beliefs' were source-supported, and one reported regression was an artifact.
expected_behavior: An intrusion counts as unsupported only if the source does not state it (verified blind against the frozen source).

regression.note: evaluation harness, not skill code: evaluation/harness/intrusion_verify.py

resolution.summary: MMF_src reported beside MMF; verdicts re-checked

lessons: Audit the metric before trusting a regression.
